in_sanskrit.name: तिलू
in_sanskrit.meaning: तिल (tila) - sesame seeds उ (u) - possessive suffix Therefore, Tilu means 'possessor of sesame seeds'
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Tilu is derived from the Sanskrit word तिल (tila), which means sesame seeds. The name is further modified by adding the possessive suffix उ (u). Thus, Tilu means 'possessor of sesame seeds'.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Tilu in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word तिल (tila)', which means sesame seeds. The name is further modified by adding the possessive suffix 'उ (u)'. Therefore, Tilu in Hindi means 'possessor of sesame seeds'.

in_marathi.name: Tilu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tilu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tilu is derived from the Sanskrit word Tilaka, which means mark or sign.
